messages:
sara: FYI the onboarding sample for Cloudflare Pages is failing after the recent export-map change.

sara: Error is during runtime import: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'RetryPolicy') — looks like the CJS entrypoint isn't exposing the retry export.

mike: Can you paste the package.json from the sample? wondering if conditional exports are pointing to .mjs only.

sara: Sure — snippet:
```json
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
}
```

aditya: That looks fine on paper. Cloudflare Workers and Pages use ESM only though, so they hit the import path — why would RetryPolicy be missing there?

mike: Could be a build step: we recently switched the bundler to rollup + esbuild for .mjs and maybe tree-shaking removed some named exports when indexed via default export. Are you seeing a default vs named import mismatch in the sample code?

sara: Sample does `const { RetryPolicy } = require('redwood-sdk')` in the onboarding script — oops, that was legacy CJS syntax. But the sample runner (local) had been using ts-node which transpiled to CJS so it worked until we changed exports.

ken: So two axes: sample app code expecting CJS, runtime being ESM-only, and typings not aligning. Also TS auto imports in editors now point to the wrong path because our package.json doesn't re-export types from the ESM build.

aditya: Quick repro: in a fresh ESM project `import sdk from 'redwood-sdk'` then `sdk.RetryPolicy` is undefined because our ESM bundle exports a default wrapper, while CJS bundle had named exports.

mike: This is a parity bug between bundles. We should either provide consistent named exports in both builds or add an interop layer that preserves named exports in the ESM build. Also update sample apps to use ESM syntax.

sara: Workaround for customers: import from the cjs path explicitly in Node (not possible on Pages). For ESM-only envs, use `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const { RetryPolicy } = Redwood.default ?? Redwood;` nasty but works.

ci-bot: draft PR created by mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1234 — adds named exports to ESM bundle and updates types entry to point at dist/index.d.ts consistently.

mike: I'll also push a quickfix to the onboarding template to use `import { RetryPolicy } from 'redwood-sdk'` after the PR lands and add a note in the docs about ESM/CJS parity.

ken: Heads-up — we should add an integration test that runs the sample in an ESM-only runtime (Cloudflare Pages or Deno) to catch this earlier.

aditya: Agreed. Also add a lint rule that flags `require()` in our sample repos or convert them to ESM syntax.

sara: Thanks y'all — will update the internal onboarding checklist and ping customer success about one early adopter hit.

mike: Following up — the PR includes a small change to package.json exports: adds an explicit "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" top-level and a "namedExportsInterop" build step. Hoping that will fix TS auto-imports too.

sara: Awesome. Marking this resolved on my side once PR merges. :thumbsup:
